sections.heading: commercetools limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet; Requires front-end / MACH assembly — not a weekend theme launch; Overkill for SMB catalogs that fit Shopify or BigCommerce because it forces process changes or add-ons around commercetools when online storefront is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Core with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain marketing automation (Core, Tailored, Premium support) at the expense of Subscription floors vs payment-processing spreads and GMV/overage fees — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Core · online storefront | Tailored | Premium support.

Alternative context: unlike Salesforce Commerce Cloud, commercetools is preferable when Mid-market and enterprise brands assembling composable storefronts because online storefront plus marketing automation (Core, Tailored, Premium support) match; prefer Salesforce Commerce Cloud when Solo founders wanting a theme + apps weekend launch because the operating loops differ.
